brief: The canvas displays a dense, repeating lattice of stylized forms resembling migrating animal herds. These interwoven shapes are rendered in rich, saturated tones, evoking the texture of deeply colored silk and a medieval tapestry. Though the forms are complex and highly structural, they appear to shift slowly and continuously across the plane, following invisible, cyclical paths. The lines suggesting data exchange are constantly reforming the pattern, creating a sense of vast, rhythmic movement across the entire field.

statement: This sketch creates a vast, rhythmic tapestry of shifting animal herds that seem to migrate across the canvas in continuous motion. Using a grid-based approach with organic noise functions, it renders flowing, interconnected forms that blend seamlessly into one another. The saturated earth tones and subtle texture evoke the rich colors and woven patterns of medieval tapestries while maintaining an ethereal, constantly evolving pattern. Each herd moves along its own cyclical path, creating an illusion of vast, coordinated movement across the entire field without any individual particle or loop that would exceed the frame budget.
